title: Tackling the Objective Inconsistency Problem in Heterogeneous Federated Optimization
layout_note: Two panels split by a grey dashed vertical rule, with a thick grey block arrow between them over the words 'Average normalized gradients instead of local changes'. Each panel stacks a parameter-space sketch, the update rule's name, its equation, a short block arrow down, and the objective it optimises.
grouping: Colour identifies the rule: blue for FedAvg (its global arrow and server dot, its bold name, its equation and its down arrow), green for the proposed rule (same items); the clients' local step chains are black in both panels and the red dashed line between client end points appears in both.
shapes_depth: Flat vector sketch: black dot at x^(t,0), black arrow chains for two clients' local steps (four and two steps), blue dashed arrows for each client's total change, a thin blue dimension line with Delta_1 above. On the right, tick marks divide client 1's total change into steps, a short green dashed arrow is the normalized change -eta d_1 = Delta_1 / tau_1, and a solid green arrow leads to the green server dot. Large flat grey block arrows; equations typeset in the rule's colour, the objective in black.
proposed_highlight: The proposed rule takes green - bold green name, green equation, green global arrow and server dot - against the baseline's blue, and the change itself is stated in words on the grey arrow between the panels.
lesson: Compare two aggregation rules on the same client step chains: keep the local steps black in both panels, draw each rule's per-client vector and resulting server step in its own colour, and write that colour's update equation and objective directly beneath its sketch.
notes: Venue and year as recorded by Semantic Scholar (venue_source: semantic-scholar); the arXiv v1 PDF names no venue. elements 'other' = the dimension lines measuring each client's change. Same marker vocabulary (black start dot, red dashed line between client end points) as fednova-2020-fig1. The whole figure is one embedded raster in the PDF (refs crop recorded one image covering the crop), so photo_share is null.

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)

taxonomy.task: normalized averaging of local updates in heterogeneous federated optimization
taxonomy.note: modality multi = abstract parameter-space sketch, no data modality

insights.structure: Two panels split by a grey dashed vertical rule, each stacking a parameter-space sketch, the rule's bold name, its update equation, a short block arrow down and the objective it optimises; a thick grey block arrow sits between the panels.
insights.data: Clients' local steps are black arrow chains from x^(t,0) to x_1^(t,4) and x_2^(t,2); per-client changes are dashed coloured vectors, the server step a solid coloured arrow to a coloured dot, with a bracket on top marking Delta_1^(t) and its normalized fraction.
insights.emphasis: The proposed rule owns green (bold green name, green equation, green arrow and server dot) against FedAvg's blue, and the change is stated in words on the grey arrow: 'Average normalized gradients instead of local changes'.
insights.flow: Left panel then right panel across the central block arrow; within each panel top-to-bottom from sketch to rule name to equation to the 'Optimizes F~(x)' objective.
insights.avoid: Superscripts crowd around the start point, and in the right panel the green dashed vectors overlap the blue dashed one so the normalized vectors are hard to separate.

arrangement.units: two unframed panels with the same skeleton separated by a grey dashed vertical rule, joined by a grey block arrow carrying the change in words
arrangement.inputs_as: black start point x^(t,0) with black local step chains
arrangement.shared: identical black local step chains and red dashed endpoint line in both panels
